| description = There are seven ganduladian widemouths in the water around this location. They are non-aggro but are social, also they wont flee at low HP if they are near a hiding gnoll. Loot is giant snake fangs and giant snake rattles.

'''Added by Bhalmancer ~ 20/11/2021'''

'''[[A gaduladian widemouth]]''' are great experience for a solo '''Necromancer''' that are just seeking XP. The drops aren't great, '''BUT''', there are 4 '''[[A hiding gnoll]]''' in that area, that are static that drop lots of '''[[Bronze Weapons]]''', and '''[[Gnoll Hide Lariat]]'''. From my experience, i been killing these since level 36 without much trouble, you just gotta make sure to bring Fish Scales to make your life easier, as you really want to be pulling from underwater and have your pet guard in a corner, to avoid your pet pathing over the bridge causing you to train and your death. There are 7 static spawns, you only really need to split one of those spawns.

'''Exp Earned as an Iksar Necromancer:'''

*36-39: 2-3%/kill
*40: 1%/kill
*41: 2% /kill
*42: 1-2% /kill
